subject: Sorry what i meant is that
author: The parkster
body:
Sorry what i meant is that you can come along if you want to and add or edit stuff. The reason why it's very Paradise orientated is because that's the latest game and the site was born just for Paradise. We've only recently expanded to the other games. We also keep the sin and styles up to date. When the main theme or style changes for any burnout game, which is new, we change too; and that makes it seem orientated to the latest game. Most players are playing Paradise and so we give most of our attention to that game, plus we play that game most. But what we really need is someone who only plays one of the older games because we lack info on those games. So you can come along and help if you want, because we really need users like you to add older game info. That way it'll become more past-game orientated. We're also close to our 600 article mark and so we need help to fill in the small articles we've made. So if you want to join and help then please do. If not then ok, but we really need your help if you mostly play Revenge. Thanks!  

                                                                                                         

Burnopedia Founder - Knowledge is the ultimate fuel...

subject: Not fair.....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
''where anyone can come along and help add and edit information about anything to do with the Burnout series.'' 

I read this line and i thought 'cool' ill have to go and take a peek, but i was quite disappointed when i read the home page, its a great site and all dont get me wrong and i think its great what you have created, but i think your initial post is quite mis leading, like Nito said it is more Paradise orientated which is why the above line that you posted mis led me. Alas though i dont like or have Paradise. Good Luck and i hope it goes well for you....😛 if it does get a bit revenge orientated shout me back and ill join....😛
